caption: The install screen asks for customer activity, staff data and edit access to products, orders, the Online Store and custom data.
On the free plan only products, payment gateways and navigation can be machine translated; pages, blogs and theme text need a paid plan.
About 30 seconds after we started, LangShop reported 125 items translated into German.
The theme preview of a translated product page in German.
Basic at $100 a year with a 14 day trial; the free plan was enough for our test, so we cancelled this screen.
